parameters.name: AcceleratorId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance for which you want to query endpoint group destination configurations.

parameters.name: EndpointGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the endpoint group for which you want to query destination configurations.

parameters.name: FromPort
parameters.description:
The start port of the backend service of the endpoint group.

Valid values: **1** to **65499**. The value of **FromPort** must be less than or equal to the value of **ToPort**.

parameters.name: ListenerId
parameters.description: The ID of the listener for which you want to query endpoint group destination configurations.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the list. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: Protocols
parameters.description:
The protocol type of the backend service of the endpoint group. Valid values:

- **TCP**: TCP protocol.

- **UDP**: UDP protocol.

- **TCP,UDP**: TCP and UDP protocols.

If this parameter is left empty, all protocol types are queried.

You can specify up to 10 protocol entries.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**.

parameters.name: ToPort
parameters.description:
The end port of the backend service of the endpoint group.

Valid values: **1** to **65499**. The value of **FromPort** must be less than or equal to the value of **ToPort**.
